_comment: nwall_sink generic event definition (--event-def / TOML event_def_file, TODO 79 section 5) for N_Wall. Modules = the provisional config/channel_map_N_Wall.txt: 0 VX2730 (ch0 beam/100, ch1-7 LaBr3, ch8-31 LS), 1 dE sector, 2-4 dE rings (inner/middle/outer, ch0-14; ch15 = pulser), 5 E sector. Keep these module/channel numbers in step with the map.

Trigger = any E sector (user, 2026-10-30): the dE vs E particle identification is what matters, and when E fires, dE almost always fires too. The l2 flag hasDE / accept dEE marks events that do have a dE sector hit (flag only: every event is written).

Window: pre 500 ns, post 1500 ns around the E trigger. The LS neutrons come AFTER the reaction (flight path not fixed yet; 1500 ns covers 0.1 MeV at 2 m, about 460 ns, with margin); pre covers the dE/ring hits and prompt gammas. group_ns 100: E sector hits of one particle (charge sharing) form one event.
Times are on the ALIGNED axis (time_calib_file is applied first). nwall_sink re-reads this file at every run start: write a temp file and mv it into place.
